//go:build postingedgebench && darwin

package postingedge

// What the harness of the night reads of what an index keeps by doc id
// (bench_night_grow_test.go, bench_night_points_test.go), with the tables as
// m2 has them: one entry for every doc id the index has room for.

// nightDeleted counts the vectors that are marked deleted.
func nightDeleted(g *growIndex) int {
	deleted := 0
	for _, d := range g.deleted {
		if d {
			deleted++
		}
	}
	return deleted
}

// nightKeys is how many doc ids the table of the live vectors and that of
// the deleted ones have room for.
func nightKeys(g *growIndex) (live, deleted int) {
	return len(g.live), len(g.deleted)
}
